name: Mniszech to Jakub Dunin, Dukla 16 March 1714, Archiwum Sanguszkow teka 290/6 (DECODE R7524)
ciphertext_source: ciphers/sanguszkow-mniszech-dunin-1714/ciphertext.tsv (A3V2-SANGTX, 4 Oct 2026, two blind passes + reconciliation, 231/232 with Bourdeau), [PLAIN] words dropped; same as potocka/r7524_tokens.txt

constraints.clear_anchors: Polish with Latin phrases (praetextu consilii, Congressow, generaliter unanimi voto, Rempublicam, czyni, niemoge, Przesylam)

cheap_tests_in_order: 1. Potocka key (Bourdeau) trial decode with key-right/key-wrong controls and shuffled null (A3V3-SANGP)
2. homophonic family_run at N=232 K=77, pl18 (A3V3-SANGP)

cheap_test_done.method: Bourdeau's key-potocka.json applied to the 232 tokens (132 covered); statistic: mean log10 4-gram prob (pl18 minus Otwinowski) over covered runs; control A key-right (held-out Otwinowski text enciphered with the key at the target's own covered positions), control B key-wrong, shuffled-target null; S=200, seeds 1-3
cheap_test_done.verdict: Potocka key does not read R7524 (control-backed negative); script ciphers/sanguszkow-mniszech-dunin-1714/potocka/potocka_trial.py --check

cheap_test_done.method: tools/family_run.py --family homophonic, N=232 K=77, pl18, seeds 1-3, restarts 8
cheap_test_done.verdict: CONTROL BELOW GATE (0.6): homophonic annealing has no power at N=232/K=77; non-test, not a negative
